source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: 31 fundamental rights (Articles 16–46); Article 17 = the right to freedom.
Nepal is a Federal Democratic Republic; sovereignty is vested in the people.
bullets.ne: नेपाल सङ्घीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्र; सार्वभौमसत्ता जनतामा निहित।

bullets.en: 7 provinces; 3 tiers of government: federal, provincial, local (753 local levels).
bullets.ne: 7 प्रदेश; 3 तहका सरकार: सङ्घीय, प्रदेश, स्थानीय (753 स्थानीय तह)।

bullets.en: Articles 6–7: Nepali in Devanagari is the official language; all mother tongues are national languages.
bullets.ne: धारा 6–7: देवनागरीको नेपाली = सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा; सबै मातृभाषा = राष्ट्रिय भाषा।

bullets.en: President = head of state; Prime Minister = head of government (executive power).
Federal Parliament: House of Representatives (275 members) + National Assembly (59).
bullets.ne: सङ्घीय संसद: प्रतिनिधि सभा (275 सदस्य) + राष्ट्रिय सभा (59)।

bullets.en: Judiciary: Supreme Court, High Courts, District Courts.
bullets.ne: न्यायपालिका: सर्वोच्च अदालत, उच्च अदालत, जिल्ला अदालत।

bullets.en: Constitutional bodies: CIAA, Auditor General, Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog), Election Commission, NHRC.
bullets.ne: संवैधानिक निकाय: अख्तियार, महालेखा परीक्षक, लोक सेवा आयोग, निर्वाचन आयोग, राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोग।

bullets.en: The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the House of Representatives.
bullets.ne: मन्त्रिपरिषद् प्रतिनिधि सभाप्रति सामूहिक रूपमा उत्तरदायी।

bullets.en: First amendment (2072): addressed Madhesi demands. Second amendment (2077): new political map including Kalapani–Lipulekh–Limpiyadhura.
bullets.ne: पहिलो संशोधन (2072): मधेसी माग सम्बोधन। दोस्रो संशोधन (2077): कालापानी–लिपुलेक–लिम्पियाधुरा सहितको नयाँ नक्सा।

bullets.en: Secularism, proportional inclusion and social justice are guiding principles.
bullets.ne: धर्मनिरपेक्षता, समानुपातिक समावेशीकरण र सामाजिक न्याय मार्गदर्शक सिद्धान्त हुन्।
